154f0bc940e9a930d9f21e9dff079140.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Pays Congratulatory Visit to Kim Il Sung University on Its 80th Founding Anniversary
paragraphs: Pyongyang, October 1 (KCNA) -- Kim Il Sung University, well known as the most authoritative and prestigious, highest seat of Juche-oriented science and education, is recording its glorious history of 80 years with pride.

Founded as the first university of the people on the untrodden path of nation building, it has demonstrated the high prestige and reputation as a "pedigree farm" of revolutionary talent education for training the backbone of our Party and state and as the highest school leading the country’s educational and sci-tech development, invariably remaining faithful to the historic mission given by the times and the revolution. Its distinguished feats serve as a solid cornerstone supporting the bright future of the Juche cause.

Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, paid a congratulatory visit to Kim Il Sung University on September 30 on the occasion of its 80th founding anniversary.

The time-honored area of Ryongnam Hill was overflowing with great emotion and joy of all the teaching staff and students honored to have at their university Marshal Kim Jong Un whom they had wanted to see so much, on the significant occasion of its 80th founding anniversary.
When Comrade Kim Jong Un arrived at the university, stormy cheers of "Hurrah" burst out.

All the participants paid the highest tribute and deep thanks to Comrade Kim Jong Un who visited the university with his boundless love, trust and warm blessings while steadily developing the socialist education of our country into a popular and advanced one to the envy of everyone, the revolutionary and patriotic education powerfully leading the national prosperity.
Comrade Kim Jong Un was courteously greeted by President Kim Sung Chan and other leading officials of Kim Il Sung University.
Educationists of the university presented fragrant bouquets to Comrade Kim Jong Un in reflection of the boundless reverence and unanimous wishes of all the teaching staff and students.

Comrade Kim Jong Un warmly congratulated all the teaching staff, students and graduates of the university who are making contributions to glorifying the immortal prestige and honor of the university and accomplishing the cause of building a powerful socialist country by devoting their ardent patriotic mind to the implementation of the Party's educational policy and the country's sci-tech development through training of talented revolutionaries, high educational and scientific achievements and passion in academic studies.

Attending the commemoration event were teachers and students of Kim Il Sung University and meritorious graduates devoting themselves in various sectors of socialist construction, and students of central-level universities in Pyongyang.

Also present were foreign guests and overseas compatriots who are taking part in the international academic forum commemorating the 80th founding anniversary of Kim Il Sung University, members of foreign diplomatic missions in the DPRK and foreign students studying at the university.
Comrade Kim Jong Un made an important speech on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of Kim Il Sung University.

Saying that the 80th founding anniversary of the parent university, which gave origin to the training of national cadres of our state, the highest school representing the intelligence and civilization of the DPRK, is a great pride and an auspicious event of the country, he extended warm congratulations and greetings of encouragement to all the teachers and researchers who are devoting themselves to teaching to remain true to their sacred duty at the holy platform, to the students who are keen on study and research with the ambition and desire to fully demonstrate the honor of the DPRK, and to all graduates who are greeting the founding anniversary of their university with deep recollection and emotion.

Paying his respect to the noble idea of having built before anything else the pedigree establishment for training talents to be the backbone of the DPRK in the first days of nation building 80 years ago, he stressed that Kim Il Sung University is the highest dignified educational institution symbolizing our state and dynamically promoting its prosperity and development and a meritorious school of high reputation as it has trained the best talents representing the wisdom and creativity of our people with high pride.

Recalling the proud 80-year history of the university which has reliably guaranteed the far-sighted plan of the country with remarkable educational and scientific achievements since the outset of the history of the Republic, he referred to the importance of the university with a history of noble patriotism and succession to play the powerful role as an engine in ensuring remarkable success of state-building strategy at the times when the national sovereignty and prestige are guaranteed by the educational development and sci-tech sovereignty, the most important and decisive period for the present and future of our motherland.

The university should stand in the vanguard of the honorable struggle for building a powerful and prosperous country, he said, clarifying the principled issues for it to implement in the van the Party Central Committee’s line of building an educational power and a talent power and lay a firm strategic orbit for the future in line with the solemn requirements of the times and expectations of the people.

Noting that the building of an educational power, a sci-tech power and a talent power is the three essential requirements and basic guarantee for the development of Korean-style socialism insisted by our Party at present, he expressed the view and expectation of the Party Central Committee on the core and leading position and role of the university in carrying out this strategic task and advanced the tasks and ways for opening up a great new phase of socialist education in the new era with high and qualitative development of the university.

Comrade Kim Jong Un ardently called for advancing with greater confidence for the DPRK, our great motherland, and for the great ideal and great success of all the people, wishing Kim Il Sung University eternal development and glory.

His passionate speech, which indicates the immortal education programme guaranteeing the rosy future of socialist Korea for all ages with his steadfast will to glorify the DPRK as a country of education, science and talents, greatly excited the participants.

When Comrade Kim Jong Un finished his speech, all the participants raised stormy cheers as a token of their solemn pledge to firmly carry forward the proud history and tradition of the university and fulfill the honorable responsibility and duty before the times and history with its core and leading role in the country’s educational and sci-tech development.
Then, a performance for commemorating the 80th founding anniversary of Kim Il Sung University was given with splendor in the presence of Comrade Kim Jong Un.

Put on the stage were songs reflecting the proud history of the university which has trained a large number of competent talents boundlessly loyal to the country and the revolution through decades since its foundation as a genuine people's university training pillars of new Korea, and famous songs on the theme of patriotism.

The audience was deeply moved by numbers recalling the important and distinguished role and proud feats of the university shining along with the victorious journey of the revolutionary cause of Juche.

The campus of the university was filled with joy and optimism of young people as the songs reflecting the ardent aspiration and desire of the people to glorify the great motherland DPRK for all ages reverberated.
The performance was acclaimed by the audience as it splendidly decorated the founding anniversary of the highest school of our state with wonderful artistic depiction.
At the end of the performance, the audiences broke into enthusiastic cheers in reverence for Comrade Kim Jong Un again.

Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed expectation and belief that the teaching staff and students of Kim Il Sung University would make a dynamic leap forward and innovations in the vanguard of the revolution in education of the new era and prepare themselves to be reliable pillars and competent talents of the DPRK who are the pride of the country and the resourcefulness of the people.

All the participants vowed to devote all their wisdom and passion with loyalty to the successful implementation of the great education programme set forth by Comrade Kim Jong Un, in return to his ardent love and trust.

Comrade Kim Jong Un's congratulatory visit to Kim Il Sung University serves as an important historic occasion in which he clarified the clear path and immortal guidelines for building a revolutionary, advanced and popular educational power of our style and opened up a great new era in which the long-term development of our great state is firmly guaranteed by education. -0-

901696c6d0b6c4405108283c96af30f5.title: Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech at Celebration of 80th Founding Anniversary of Kim Il Sung University
paragraphs: Pyongyang, October 1 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a speech "Respects to the Glorious 80-Year History of Kim Il Sung University" on September 30 on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of Kim Il Sung University.
The full text of the speech is as follows:
Teachers, researchers and students of Kim Il Sung University, our state's number one base for training talented personnel and the highest institution of science and education,
Officials and employees of the university,
Dear comrades,
I am very pleased to be celebrating with you the historic day when this prestigious university is greeting its 80th founding anniversary.

As I am standing here, I can see the university's thousands of educators and 10 000 or so students brimming with enthusiasm. This fills my heart with trust and confidence in the powerful body of personnel who will shoulder the responsibility for the future of our state.

This university is the parent body in which the training of our state's native cadres began, the "pedigree farm" where large numbers of backbone personnel with loyalty to the Party and the revolution have been produced, and the highest academic institution which represents Korea's intellect and civilization. Indeed, the university's 80th founding anniversary is a source of great pride and an auspicious event for our country.

On the occasion of this anniversary of the university, which is famed for its most honourable name and history, I would like, first of all, to extend my heartfelt congratulations to all its teachers and researchers who are devoting themselves heart and soul to performing their ennobling duties faithfully at this sacred educational institution.
I also offer my warm encouragement to all the students who are applying themselves to learning and research with an ambitious aim and passion to exalt the honour of this country.

In addition, my greetings go to the foreign students, who, together with our students, work hard to enrich their knowledge and deepen the feelings of friendship, as well as to the Korean educationalists from overseas and foreign friends who have been invited here to share this significant event with us.

I send my greetings also to many comrades who are present at this celebration, and to all the graduates from this university who, wherever they live in the country, would be recollecting their student days with deep emotion and extending their best wishes to their alma mater on its founding anniversary.
Comrades,
As I am on this historic campus, I more deeply appreciate the ennobling ideal that was set forth in the initial days of nation building 80 years ago.

This "pedigree farm" for training talented personnel who would form the backbone of our state was built before anything else, and it was based on a determination to establish a powerful, independent and sovereign state lest another bitter disgrace of history be brought upon the Korean people, resourceful, diligent and righteous. I cannot but admire the loftiness of this ideal.

This day 80 years back was a momentous day which witnessed, along with the birth of a new, democratic Korea, the founding of the parent body for training its valuable native cadres, and it was a historic watershed which highlighted Korea's firm determination to shape its future confidently on the principle of achieving prosperity by dint of self-reliance.
This was how Korea's education took its first step.

Many universities in the world boast long histories and high reputations, but I am sure there is no such university as Kim Il Sung University, which was established from scratch thanks to the efforts of the working people, has remained faithful to those people for so long years and has produced so many excellent personnel who have worked with devotion to build a genuine people's state.

As the highest educational institution in the country, this is an authoritative university that symbolizes our state and has propelled it towards prosperity and development, and a prestigious university that has produced most talented personnel representing our people's wisdom and creativity.

At the time of its establishment in the initial days of nation building, the university had only 68 teachers, seven faculties and 1 500 or so students. However, the first step it took was very significant and admirable, since it represented the Korean people's high aspirations and self-confidence.
In following its historic course through decades and generations, the university has rendered a great contribution to promoting the development of the state.

With this university as the parent body, a number of universities and colleges have been established, which has helped setting the framework of our education. By responding to the call of the times for the past 80 years, graduates from this university have strived hard to perform their ennobling duties and responsibilities as main pillars at the Party's and the state's leadership organs and in major sectors and units; their role as the state's loyal and devoted servants has been very active.
Still today, these graduates hold the state's important positions.
This fact illustrates the university's role and position in the development of the state.

Glorious is the university's 80-year history; from the first days of our Republic to this date, the university has achieved notable successes in education and scientific research to support this country's foundations and provide a firm guarantee for its future prosperity.

I courteously propose that we pay our respects to the university's first Chancellor Ho Hon as well as to Kim Ji Jong, To Sang Rok, Pak Si Hyong, Chae Hui Guk, So Sang Guk and other elder educators, who left an indelible imprint on the pages of its glorious history through their high academic authority and successes in education and scientific research.
Comrades,

At this moment when we look back on the annals of history of the university, which is replete with ennobling programmes of patriotism and succession, we ought to recollect instructions with due attention.

At the celebration held on the first anniversary of this university, the great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung said that its characteristics lie in the fact that it is a people's university which provides the sons and daughters of the people with the freedom to learn and serves the purpose of promoting the people's wellbeing, developing our national culture to be worthy of the world's admiration and building a people's country.
This is a truly meaningful remark.

Kim Il Sung University is a solid, core stronghold that reliably guarantees the advance of the socialist cause by employing the Juche-based ideas on nation building and education for its mainstay and by training talented personnel who personify the wisdom and resourcefulness of the people.
Just at its inception, the university began to share its destiny with our state, and its development has since been part and parcel of our state's development.

The prestige and dignity the university has won through its historic struggle and exploits is something to be proud of, but we must in no way hold it simply for a historical record or a legacy of the past.
More important for us is the coming 80 years than the past 80 years, and heavier is the responsibility we bear for the future.
This is the time when the functions and role of the university are incomparably important and decisive for the present and future of our country.
We must be much more powerful.

Surpassing the era of harbouring a great ambition, dreams and desires, we should usher in an era of putting them into practice and reality, and more importantly, we should have such a will and self-confidence.

In reality, our socialist construction is going on in greater depth in greater realms, so it requires competent cadres and able personnel who can skilfully lead the relevant sectors, fields and regions with confidence in their revolutionary cause. This demands that the university further enhance its leading role in developing the science and education of the country by leaps and bounds and in terms of quality.
This is clearly an era when both national sovereignty and prestige depend on educational development and sovereignty in scientific and technological research.

Only when this university produces such good revolutionary personnel, namely, first-rate personnel equipped with an ennobling spirit and morality, high scientific and theoretical qualifications and creative abilities, can we preserve the character of the Korean revolution which is free from stagnation or retreat, and make an excellent success of our strategy for nation building.
It is by no means wrong to say that the future of our country, to say nothing of today and tomorrow of education and science, is determined precisely at this campus.
In our country none of its peers could be on a par with this university in terms of importance of their missions as each of its affairs has a direct bearing on the dignity and future of the country.
Needless to say, the university should take the lead in the honourable struggle to build a powerful and prosperous country.
This view of ours and the common understanding and expectations of everyone in this country precisely stand for the honour, glory and sacred duty of this university.

Considering this serious demand of the times and the expectations of the people, and facing this crucial historic point of national development, no other unit but this very university should rise up just like it did to lay the foundations for education and scientific research in its initial days. In this way it can make another event worth mentioning as its re-founding, and lay a solid strategic line for the future.

In recent years the Party Central Committee put forward the line of building an educational power and a talent power, and has consistently maintained the stand with which to give priority to educational development; it made a series of important decisions for modernization of education and the building of an educational power, and has effectively led the educational sector to achieve historic successes and make a trend of change and development.

An educational power, a sci-tech power and a talent power to be built are the three essential requirements and a basic guarantee for the development of our style of socialism, which our Party advocates at the moment.

It is essential to prepare the leading, driving force if we are to accomplish the three-point strategic task, that is, building an educational power, a sci-tech power and a talent power, and this university should take the position. This is the view and expectation of the Party Central Committee.

The university should play a core and leading role in carrying out several urgent tasks that still remain undone in the field of education and, more importantly, in overhauling the education system of the country as a whole.

The educational power we are going to build is a revolutionary, advanced and people-oriented one of our own style. To this end, the main orientation should be to guarantee the development and prosperity of our socialist state by dint of education; the fundamental principle, to strictly adhere to the Party's ideas and theories on education; the basic task, to train talented revolutionaries, possessed of excellent spiritual and moral traits and high intellectual and practical abilities, who will serve the state and the people; the main goal, to reduce regional differences in the educational level and make all the people well-versed in science and technology; the important function, to support and lead the comprehensive development of the state; the main motive force for development, to build up the ranks of teachers in terms of quality; the basic way, to update the educational structure, system, contents and methods and ensure the qualitative improvement of the educational conditions and environment; and the basic guarantee, to strengthen the guidance and assistance by the Party and the state and increase social support for education. In the long run, we will develop our education into the one to which we can fully entrust the future of our state and people.

Kim Il Sung University should bolster its position as a reliable centre for training talented personnel that symbolizes the level of our education, represents the development of our state, and showcases our bright future.
It should train talented revolutionaries who will serve their country and people both in name and in reality.

Because of a historical factor that compelled our state to pioneer a path for national defence and prosperity in a very special geopolitical environment, and because of our people's strong desire for building a powerful country, the levels and hallmarks of talented personnel required by our country were also unusual.

The university should produce not merely experts with qualifications in their specialist fields; it is required to train able revolutionary personnel who will faithfully serve our state and our people.

In trying to develop it into one of the most prestigious universities in the world, we are not aiming to raise its prestige or imitate others; our goal is to train more excellent personnel who will make a genuine contribution to accomplishing our revolutionary cause and become strong buttresses in building up our national power and providing our people with a happy life.

The contents and methods of teaching should be steadily updated in keeping with the trend of the times, but the true intention behind founding the university and its main function should remain unchanged.
The aspirations of all officials, teachers, researchers and students of the university should be in accord with the ennobling ideal of patriotism.

The university should set it as its immutable educational programme, its first and foremost one, to train all its students to be elite personnel who cherish the Party's intention and will as an element of their own faith and regard it as their lifelong goal to build the future as designed by the Party.

It should encourage all its students to have a good understanding of our Party's ideas and policies, cultivate revolutionary traits, and learn from the thoughts, spirit and willpower which their seniors cherished in training their minds and broadening their horizons of knowledge to leave remarkable imprints in the history of development of the Party and the state.

It should work out and put into effect proper courses of education and edification so that the students, fully aware of their heavy duty, can train themselves in practice while gaining firsthand experience of the reality through various production internships and socio-political activities.

I stress once again: This is a people's university which was established thanks to the ardent patriotism of our people who were determined to develop theirs into a prosperous and powerful country, and its dignified name, symbolic of its prestige and honour, was also instituted according to the unanimous will of our people.
Our people's expectations of the university were always unusual, and their desire for it still remains unchanged.

Before being recognized by the world in terms of any certain indexes or items, it should naturally be appreciated by the country and the people for its true and sound educational courses and the successes resulting from them, and its position should be verified by them.

As it is a learning space for the people's sons and daughters, the university should not produce self-centred or fame-seeking persons who try to gain academic qualifications or to lay a springboard for their own careers; it should produce genuine patriots who will make devoted efforts for the country and the people, true servants who will faithfully support the country.
Any unfair and ambiguous elements that are detested by the people and unacceptable to them must never be allowed to exist in this people's university.
The discipline of Kim Il Sung University, which trains the hardcore personnel for nation building, is directly linked with the national trait.

There should prevail on this campus the discipline and climate of remaining faithful to the Constitution of the Republic and to moral obligation, and all hues of lazy and unsound trends that run counter to the mission and principles of socialist education and have nothing to do with the revolutionary atmosphere of our times should be prevented from getting a foothold in the university.
Comrades,

Today, availing myself of this opportunity when I am meeting with you, teachers and researchers of the university, I want to make a particular reference to the need to improve the quality of education.

We should adhere to the principle of setting the high objective for qualitative development as the lifeblood of education at all levels, and set up an educational system of high qualitative level as quickly as possible.

The university, shouldering the important political responsibility for achieving the qualitative development of education, should provide a guarantee for ensuring that the policy-oriented decisions and directives of the Party Central Committee on advanced education prove effective in practice.

By comparing the present state of our education with the global trends in educational development, it should discover a shortcut to attaining a higher stage and study and update its educational structure and system so that it can produce more excellent revolutionary personnel as we need.
It should improve the contents and methods of education in keeping with the present reality that is different from the past and according to the rapidly-changing trends of the times.

It should improve the contents of education in the direction of training personnel who are possessed of a scientific way of thinking and practical methodology in addition to a rich knowledge of their major and relevant fields, and it should also steadily develop its teaching methods so that the students can have great abilities to analyze, think creatively and apply in practice.
The fundamental key to improving the quality of education is decisively to enhance the qualifications of teachers.
I regard strengthening the ranks of university teachers as the most important prerequisite for building an educational power.

However advanced the educational equipment, facilities, system, environment, methods and others may be, the qualitative instruction by a teacher is unthinkable apart from his or her leading role. So, it is essential to reinforce and perfect the teacher training system, and this should be the starting point for all affairs, I think.
The quality of education at Kim Il Sung University represents our state's level of education.

The university should create standard models for most rational, productive and efficient structure, system, contents and methods of education, and use its influence in developing the country's education as a whole.
Comrades,
Kim Il Sung University is the highest academic institution that supports the country's dignity and prosperity with the twin pillars of education and science.

Our Party expects that the university, as befitting the country's cardinal and authoritative educational institution and its academic research institute, will play a greater role in developing the country's science.

The university should defend our Party's revolutionary ideology and theories, steadily explore and develop more academic domains needed for the present and future of nation building, enhance the state's competitive edge in science and technology, and give a strong push to the research projects that are conducive to putting the economy on an advanced and modern basis.

The university should encourage the sector of basic sciences, which is its peculiar advantage and a source of pride for it, to perform a distinct role in rendering services to carrying out the ambitious tasks for the technological revolution in the new era and opening up a shortcut to the future.

In order to add lustre to its honour as an authoritative and influential university in line with the demands of both global trend and our reality, it should play a core role in creating cutting-edge industries.

This university, which has nearly all academic subjects of theoretical and applied sciences and many outstanding personnel, can serve as a base for establishing those industries. It also can be called fertile soil capable of growing new sprouts and stems of our economy that will compete with the world on its own terms.

This is quite feasible if scientific planning is followed by investment and organizational work, since the university has prestigious research institutes of distinguished service, and has accumulated experience in the course of integrating education, scientific research and production.
I believe the university will take a lion's share in completely upgrading the features of our national economy and putting it on a new trajectory of development.

As befitting a world-class university and the highest-level university in the country, it should proactively conduct exchanges and cooperation with famous universities and scientific research institutions in other countries.

All the teachers and researchers of the university should make strenuous efforts to become the foundations for training excellent revolutionary personnel, not with their honour or academic degrees and titles but with conscience as educators and with whole-hearted devotion.

The illustrious educators who had their names recorded in the history of the university were stronger than any others in their desire for, and demand in, training even one more talented person in their academic fields for the good of the country.
They were literally faithful servants of the country and patriots, before being teachers.

When all the educators of the new generation hold in reverence the ennobling spirit and conscience of the preceding generations and adopt the aspiration and will to carry them forward as their ideological feelings, the history in which patriotism begets patriotism and a talent trains more talented personnel will go on.

All the educators of the university should, with a more soaring spirit and with more steadfast fortitude and will, open up a new, great phase of socialist education in the new era and contribute to the rapid development and prosperity of the country.
Dear students of Kim Il Sung University,
The honour of this dignified university and the future of the country depend on your shoulders.

You should set by yourselves the height of your practical abilities to be attained during your university days and value every second of your university life with a single desire to remain honourable before your motherland by dint of your knowledge and talents.
With a sense of sacred consciousness, you should continue to cultivate a good habit of studying and to create an atmosphere of innovation and competition.

You should have a strong sense of self-respect and self-confidence to make your country more powerful and prosperous, an ambition and courage to strike the world with admiration, and excellent academic records associated with your conscience and passion.
I put trust in the educators and students of Kim Il Sung University and its graduates.
You should learn and work harder for the prosperity of our state, the wellbeing of our people, and the advance of our cause.

As our goal is far-reaching and our task is enormous, the existence of talented personnel will be brought into bolder relief day by day, and the strenuous, devoted efforts made for the present struggle will produce rich, valuable fruits.
I appeal to all comrades who are full of enthusiasm on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of the university to write its dignified history more proudly.
Let us advance forward, full of greater confidence, for Korea, our great motherland, and for our great ideals and for our great successes.
I wish Kim Il Sung University eternal development and glory.
Thank you. -0-

736fce24e6b4e2410cc643b05e133ed5.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Teachers and Researchers of Kim Il Sung University
paragraphs: Pyongyang, October 2 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on October 1 had a photo session with teachers and researchers of Kim Il Sung University who significantly greeted the 80th founding anniversary of the university.

All the participants paid boundless gratitude to Comrade Kim Jong Un, who attended the celebration of the university founding anniversary and provided an immortal programme for the rapid development of socialist education in the new era, repeatedly showing deep trust and highest glory.

The 80-year history covered by the university along with the prosperity of the Republic is an epitome of history proving the validity and vitality of our Party's policy of attaching importance to education and talents and a proud course showcasing the spirit and resourcefulness of the DPRK advancing with strong aspiration and high ambition, Comrade Kim Jong Un said, adding that it is the pride and auspicious event for our Party, state and people to celebrate with splendor the founding anniversary of the parent university, the most prestigious and highest school which opened up the origin of revolutionary talents training.

He expressed high respect and deep thanks to the noble life and patriotic devotion of teachers and researchers who are devoting their all to the future of the country with a noble sense of responsibility and pure conscience as educators, saying that the unknown efforts of educators, who have become nourishment for the growth of disciples unselfishly and without any reward and guided them along the road of true human life, are behind many talents ensuring the dynamic advance of our motherland to open up the new era of great transformation.

Stressing once again that the mission and role of Kim Il Sung University are very important and the expectations of the Party and the people in it is very great, he expressed belief that the teachers and researchers of the university would reliably guarantee the overall development of socialism by playing a core and leading role in carrying out the strategic tasks for building an educational power, a sci-tech power and a talent power.
The participants' enthusiastic cheers for Marshal Kim Jong Un rocked the foot of Ryongnam Hill.

All the teachers, researchers and officials of the university hardened their will to more fully display the dignity and honor of the university in the vanguard of the glorious struggle for building a strong and prosperous great country and on the road of loyalty and repayment for upholding the Party and the revolution with brilliant results in the training of best talents and scientific research, regarding the great programme of socialist education in the new era clarified by Comrade Kim Jong Un as an immortal guideline. -0-

2bd661f15c5178018e860a9ce35e555d.title: Strategic Missile Launching Drill Conducted in Eastern Region of DPRK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, October 4 (KCNA) -- At dawn of October 3, a drill was staged to launch an intermediate-range strategic missile from an eastern region of the DPRK toward the East Sea of Korea.

The drill was conducted as part of the efforts to train the missile soldiers operating the hypersonic strategic weapon system in handling their equipment and evaluate the reliability, efficiency and mobility of the DPRK's war deterrent.

Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw the launching drill on the spot.
Among the spectators were Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the C.C., WPK, and Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration of the DPRK.

Noting that it is a very important measure for ensuring national security and a responsible action of our army to build up the powerful and reliable nuclear deterrent through sustained verification of major components of the war deterrent, improvement of their performance and mastery of the capabilities for their successful operation and to show the counterattack means of our army in constant mobilization posture, Comrade Kim Jong Un said:

"Through today's launching drill, the strategic missile soldiers have fully demonstrated their professional qualifications and counterattack posture, clearly showing that they are very good at operating the major offensive weapon system and they are always available for mobilization. They also added confidence to our deterrent.
I highly appreciate commanding officers and soldiers of the missile unit who participated in the drill.
We must continue our responsible efforts nonstop to constantly and repeatedly make the enemy recognize the reliability and fatality of our strategic offensive means.
This is a form of exercising deterrent.
As always expressed clearly, such activities on our part are definitely aimed at more rapidly developing the country's nuclear war deterrent.
This is indispensable for protecting national security and stability in today's geopolitical environment. There will be no change in such view and line of ours.
We must deter various threats by dint of powerful deterrent and ensure a safer environment for the building and activities of our state."
The missile used in the drill was launched towards the northeast direction and hit the target point at 43°36' 28.04" latitude and 138°00' 47.02" longitude, 1 000 km away on the East Sea of Korea.

Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed expectation and belief that all the missile forces would remain faithful to their missions of defending the sovereignty and security of the Republic in a responsible combat posture. -0-

81d1cc992751a979ee10be7d5d14c786.title: Performance Given to Celebrate 81st Founding Anniversary of WPK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- A celebration performance was given with splendor at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on Oct. 10, the 81st founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea, now that the people's absolute confidence in the WPK, the great guide and invincible vanguard for the Juche revolution, is growing stronger along with the significant October holiday.

The WPK is ushering in an era of dignity and glory, a long-cherished desire of all generations of this land, while firmly preserving its revolutionary character and true nature, never to be found in other parts of the world, without any deviation and fading from the day when it solemnly declared its founding with the emblem representing the people embroidered on the red flag held aloft in Paektu. The venue of the performance was overflowing with deep reverence for the Party, alongside the audiences recollecting with deep emotion the sacred founding history of the Party and its immortal exploits.
Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, watched the performance.

Stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" went up among the audiences paying the highest glory and respect to Comrade Kim Jong Un, the great leader of the ever-victorious WPK, who is representing the dignity and mightiness of the DPRK.
Comrade Kim Jong Un warmly waved back to the enthusiastically cheering crowds as a token of his congratulations to all the participants on the Party founding day.

Among the audience were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other leading officials of the Party and the government, officials of the Party Central Committee, ministries, national agencies and armed forces organs, creators, artistes, youth and students and other citizens in Pyongyang.
Present there on invitation were diplomatic envoys and members of foreign missions here.

The performance began with prelude "Long Live the Workers' Party of Korea" and "Fly High, Our Party Flag". Put on the stage were all-people hymns to the WPK and patriotic songs, played in good artistic harmony with vocals, dance, acrobatics, gymnastics and military band's performance.

Enthusiastically singing the odes to the Party, produced by the sacred experiences of the people, the performers sang high praises of the glorious history and immortal exploits of the WPK that built on this land a dignified country, where people's dreams and ideals come true, and made great world-startling miracles and changes century after century, hewing the untrodden path of the socialist cause, arduous yet sacred, for over 80 years.

The audience fervently applauded the famous songs which made them feel proud of the greatness and mightiness of the WPK that has written the longest history as a ruling party in the world, fulfilling the most righteous mission and implementing the noble idea, reminding them of their great honor and fortune of having the wise political staff confidently steering our cause straight to victory.

Performers gave other colorful numbers representing the ardent desire and enthusiasm of the people determined to realize the far-reaching ambition for the comprehensive development of socialism, single-mindedly supporting their motherly Party.

The performance, which ended with the finale "The National Anthem of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea", added to the conviction and optimism that the path being taken by the DPRK is always the one of justice and truth and an immensely beautiful and bright future is in store for it as it is led by the great Party.
The performance was highly acclaimed by the audiences for the songs of undying faith and patriotism.
Expressing satisfaction at the successful performance, Comrade Kim Jong Un warmly waved back to the performers and audiences.
The performance added to the joy of all the people celebrating the birthday of the great motherly Party, the most sacred and glorious holiday. -0-

e6a262ae36739c46ecd3505ad4b4f68a.title: National Defence Revolution Museum Inaugurated in DPRK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, October 13 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea is steering the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered in Paektu to a brilliant victory, consolidating the national power in every way and dynamically opening up a new era of comprehensive national development, a new chapter in the building of a powerful country. Now that the whole country is overflowing with the people's great confidence in the WPK, the National Defence Revolution Museum under the Second Economy Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was inaugurated with due ceremony on the occasion of the 81st founding anniversary of the WPK.

The museum comprehensively deals with the sacred history of the WPK's guidance on national defence industry and its great fruits, associated with its steadfast faith of independence, resolute determination, painstaking effort and passionate sincerity for taking responsible care of the country and the people. It is the grand national treasure house of eternal significance showcasing the Korean people's strong spirit and steadfast revolutionary will and the absolute power of the DPRK.
A ceremony for inaugurating the museum took place with splendour on October 11.

The venue for the ceremony was brimming with deep reverence for Comrade Kim Jong Un who has ushered in the greatest heyday of the DPRK's military strength with his outstanding military strategy and idea, extraordinary and unique leadership, great devotion and tenacious execution faculty.
The Central Military Band of the Ministry of National Defence gave a peculiar dynamic performance.

All the participants paid the highest tribute and glory to Comrade Kim Jong Un, who is representing the mightiness and heroism of the great Party, country and people and their sacred dignity and brilliant honour.

Present at the ceremony were the members of the Party central leadership, including the secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, leading officials of the national defence industry, commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence, commanders of different services of the Korean People's Army, commanders of its major large combined units, builders, and officials and employees of the museum.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
The participants watched a video dealing with the weapons and equipment newly armed with by the KPA.
Kim Jong Sik, member of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and first department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, addressed the ceremony.

Saying that the National Defence Revolution Museum serves as a proud review of the history of protracted and glorious development made by our munitions industry under the guidance of the WPK and an epitome of the level, appearance and capability of our national defence power, he stressed that the establishment of the museum representing and symbolizing the exploits performed by the Party for the country's today and morrow is the greatest celebration of its historic course of profound significance by the times and the people.

The strategic programme of the Party on defence development and the tasks for implementing it literally constituted a revolution for pioneering new defence science and technology and building a new munitions industry, he said, noting in an excited tone that Comrade Kim Jong Un initiated the gigantic revolution, unprecedented in the world's history of defence building, and has guided it personally.

Stressing that the museum, which comprehensively represents the great patriotic spirit, the defence building line and outstanding leadership of Comrade Kim Jong Un, is the greatest glory dedicated to the 80 year-long history of the WPK, he said the museum clearly indicates the path to be followed by us and reconfirms the origin of our self-confidence.
Comrade Kim Jong Un cut the inauguration tape.
He went round the museum with the participants in the ceremony.

Looking back with deep emotion on the sacred history of the Juche-oriented defence industry, which was pioneered along with the founding of the WPK and has undergone successful development, and on the stories recorded in the arduous course of pioneering the modernization of defence industry and beating its untrodden path, he said that the museum is the immortal archive and the greatest national treasure house that intensively and intuitively show how the dignity and security of the DPRK and the happiness of its people are defended and how peace of this land is achieved.

He proudly said that such revolutionary treasure as the National Defence Revolution Museum is a great historical one that can be possessed only by the WPK, which has strenuously taken the path, to be proud of and glorious before the country and posterity, without a moment's delay, and a precious monument which can be built only by the powerful state and people with their absolute strength powerful enough to defend themselves.

The level reached by our defence industry today is the zenith of glory and honour won with the spirit and strength of the DPRK and its people's resourcefulness, and a priceless victory brought about by the tenacity, patriotism and loyalty of the people who unconditionally supported and encouraged the WPK's original line of self-defence and policy of defence development in the face of severe trials and difficulties, he said.

Saying that it is the WPK's due obligation and peculiar mode of action to build the defence industry, most powerful in the world, as it was founded with its very mission to take full responsibility for the destiny of the people, he affirmed that the powerful Juche-based weaponry, which serve as stepping stones to dramatic promotion of the national position, will be developed and completed in a more strenuous manner through the course of unique development and evolution, alongside the scale and contents of the museum being further expanded and enriched with the passage of time.

He expressed belief that the officials and lecturers of the museum would fulfill their responsibility and duty as the red information workers and ideological guards of the WPK who convey the history of the self-reliant defence building of the DPRK forever, cherishing the great pride and honour of working at the WPK's revolutionary history museum.
The participants deeply realized the iron truth - we will always emerge victorious as the WPK guides the Korean revolution - and the vitality of the WPK's line of self-reliant defence.

Members of the Party central leadership hardened their firm will to remain single-mindedly loyal to the revolutionary leadership of Comrade Kim Jong Un who is powerfully demonstrating the dignity and greatness of the Party, state and people while leading the historic struggle for accomplishing the sacred cause of building a rich country with a strong army, regarding self-reliant defence as the mainstay for defending the sovereignty and national interests and developing the revolution. -0-

a1aa4999d4d6e3129717a015272723eb.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Goes round Venue of Garment and Footwear Exhibition in Light Industry
paragraphs: Pyongyang, October 20 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, went round the venue of a garment and footwear exhibition in light industry on October 19.
He was accompanied by leading officials of the Party and the government.
Comrade Kim Jong Un was greeted on the spot by senior officials of the Light Industry Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.

On display at the National Garment and Footwear Exhibition-2026 to be held under the theme of "Enthusiasm for developing new products and improving their quality" are more than 70 700 garments of over 30 kinds and over 170 000 pairs of shoes of over 60 kinds which were manufactured by more than 270 garment, footwear and bag production units, including major light industry factories and the newly-built city and county garment factories to suit the tastes of the Korean people and the world trend of development.

Comrade Kim Jong Un went round with satisfaction the venue of the exhibition which comprehensively shows the features of the development of the light industry sector which is promoting the improvement of the material and cultural welfare of the people and making rapid progress.

Saying that the national light industry goods exhibition which has been held in every October is intimately settled in the cultural and emotional life of our people, he appreciated that the current exhibition has been prepared, making another progress in scale, content and form, which are different from last year's.

He said that all aspects including the brand and display, to say nothing of the shape, colour and quality of the products on display clearly show the rapid and substantial development of the light industry sector which is waging a hot emulation while concentrating efforts on improving the quality and developing new products, adding that the current exhibition eloquently signifies the daily-increasing cultural level of our people and the development of our light industry.

He said that dozens of kinds of smart and quality garment and footwear products presented by the city and county garment factories and other regional light industry factories newly built under the Party's policy of regional development are squarely competing with the products of the central-level factories, adding that this is a clear demonstration of the validity and vitality of the Party's policy aimed at eliminating the differences between the central and local areas and between urban and rural areas and achieving simultaneous and balanced development of the whole country.

Comrade Kim Jong Un said that progress in light industry should lead the noble and beautiful trend, civilization and development of our society by further accelerating the vigorous development trend of light industry so that the foundations of light industry, which have already been established in the central and local areas and are being expanded every year, can meet the people's growing cultural and emotional requirement and ensure their colorful life.

Saying that it is most important for the light industry sector to give precedence to designing of the products and develop it, Comrade Kim Jong Un stressed the need to organize design festivals and exhibitions in various forms and methods, learn about the cultural tastes of the working people through them and introduce them into production, thus increasing the economic effectiveness and scientific accuracy of the production of goods.

He set forth the orientation and tasks for the development of light industry including the issue of encouraging the development of peculiar national costumes of Korean style, the issue of producing more diverse light industrial goods with elements symbolic of the national flag of the DPRK to inspire the people with patriotism and make patriotism permeate the daily life of society, the issue of widely publishing and disseminating various kinds of picture albums and magazines introducing new garment and footwear products on an annual basis, the issue of raising the hot wind of emulation among the production units at all levels with their monopoly indices and the issue of consistently ensuring the quality in the production of schoolchildren's uniforms, bags and shoes. -0-
